name: Ivanská náves
evidence: register + painting log: camera on the green looking NNE towards the fire-station tower; OSM fire station DHZO (48.19021,17.25677) lies 25 deg from the register point, the reference photo rozalia_square_park_path_taz666_2013.jpg looks along the park towards it
the painting is a generalised composition: chapel of St Rosalia ahead (OSM 314635232, 21 m NE of the register point), houses left and right

known deviation: the real post office (OSM node 30343810) stands on the EAST side of the square (ESE of the camera, right/behind); the painting shows the POSTA house on the LEFT. A door cannot be moved without repainting the house; its exit stays the painted door (up)

exits.why: the railway halt lies NNE, dead ahead (Nadrazna is reached from the north end of the square); now the village street straight ahead between the post-office house and the chapel (the former S34 street mouth)
the painted POSTA door (see the deviation above)
Maticny dom (culture hall) stands at the NW corner of the square on Moyzesova, 44 deg left of the camera axis; now the dirt road out of the left edge (the former S31 zone)
the road at the back right towards the manor's service courtyard (NNE, slightly right)

the manor park lies NE; the walk leaves the green east along Stefanikova (right of the NNE camera), out of the right edge in front of the big linden. The return S37.to_S32 is a path into the picture (up), so no turn-round at the edges

checked: 2026-10-07 exit-geography pass (owner: every next-location arrow points where the place really lies)
